messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert: High tail latency observed for embeddings in eu-west-1. 5xxs rising, customer impact suspected. Incidents channel auto-created: <#incidents|incidents> · details: https://internal.ops/redwood/inc/6159873210 :rotating_light:

sophie (oncall): Acked. Joining now, switching pager. Oncall rotation: sophie -> taking lead.

raj (eng): I see increased p99 on embedding generation, root traces show spikes at the routing layer with repeated downstream retries. KV cache miss rate up 7x in eu-west-1. hypothesis: degraded router rollout + cache eviction pattern.

anna (ops): Noted. Autoscaler hasn't kicked for the shard due to a config typo in scale policy (min_replicas=0). Fixing policy then warming. Pushing change to staging now.

sophie (oncall): Quick ask: customer impact scope? Any customers in APAC affected?

raj (eng): Primary impact confined to eu-west-1 embeddings endpoint. US/asia routed fine. Some EU customers will see slow responses or timeouts for embedding calls. No data loss.

maria (comms): Preparing initial status page and customer note. Draft below — keep short and explicit. PTAL for legal/ops.

maria (comms): ```Initial status page draft (please confirm):
- Summary: We are investigating elevated latency and failed embedding requests in the eu-west-1 region.
- Impact: Some customers may experience increased response times or errors when creating embeddings in eu-west-1. Other regions are operating normally.
- Mitigation: Engineers are routing traffic away from affected routers and applying a scaling policy fix. No customer data is at risk.
- Next update: in 15 minutes.```

lou (legal): :eyes: Language looks fine re: no data loss. Recommend replacing "No customer data is at risk" with "We have no evidence of customer data exposure at this time."

maria (comms): Good call. Updated.

sophie (oncall): Ops/Eng, can you confirm mitigation steps and ETA for next update?

anna (ops): Deployed fix to autoscaling policy (min_replicas=1). Kicking warm-up; routing change in progress to shift traffic to healthy pods. ETA for measurable improvement: ~8-12 minutes.

raj (eng): Adding quick hotfix to router rollout to revert problematic config (rolling restart of 3 nodes). Doing canary then full. Estimated 10-15 minutes.

maria (comms): Publishing initial status now with legal wording. I'll pin link to thread after publish. Copy below final:```We are investigating elevated latency and failed embedding requests in the eu-west-1 region. Some customers may experience increased response times or errors when creating embeddings in eu-west-1. We are routing traffic away from affected routers and applying a scaling policy fix. We have no evidence of customer data exposure at this time. Next update: in ~15 minutes.```

maria (comms): Published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/6159873210 (Initial update) :white_check_mark:

raj (eng): Canary router revert looks good, canary latency dropped to baseline. Proceeding with full rollout.

anna (ops): Autoscaling warm-up showing new instances healthy, cache warming under way. Errors decreasing.

sophie (oncall): Good. Let's prepare a follow-up update that shows scope and actions taken. Maria, draft follows-up with ETA and whether to advise customer workarounds.

maria (comms): Draft follow-up: ```Update (T+12m): We have applied a routing rollback and fixed an autoscaling policy that prevented capacity from scaling. Error rates and latency have declined and continue to improve. Customers in eu-west-1 should see restored embedding performance; some requests may still experience elevated latency during cache warm-up. No evidence of data exposure. We are monitoring. Next update: T+30m or when resolved.```

lou (legal): Fine. No legal flags.

sophie (oncall): Agree with wording. @raj @anna please confirm when you consider this resolved so we can publish resolve note and close pager.

raj (eng): Monitoring for 15 minutes post-rollout. If p99 stable and errors <= baseline, will mark resolved.

(12 minutes later)

raj (eng): p99 and 5xxs have returned to baseline for 10 minutes. Cache warm-up ongoing but not customer impacting. I consider this resolved from an infrastructure perspective.

anna (ops): Confirmed. All autoscaled replicas healthy. No further mitigations required.

maria (comms): Draft resolve notice: ```Resolved: The elevated latency and errors for embeddings in eu-west-1 have been resolved. We reverted a router rollout that introduced instability and corrected an autoscaling configuration that prevented capacity from increasing. Performance has returned to normal and we continue to monitor. We have no evidence of customer data exposure. If you are still seeing issues, please contact support.```

sophie (oncall): LGTM. Maria, publish resolved and close the incident. I'll close the pager after publish.

maria (comms): Published resolved update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/6159873210/resolved :white_check_mark:

sophie (oncall): Pager closed. Thanks everyone for fast turnaround. Filing short post-incident note to bind with monitoring playbook.

maria (comms): I'll post a small customer-facing follow-up email template if needed.

lou (legal): Recommend retention of logs for 90 days for review.

sophie (oncall): Noted. Assigning follow-up: ops to add autoscale policy unit test + eng to vet router rollout gating. Creating ticket: https://projects.redwood.ai/RED-4321

raj (eng): On it. Will add a pre-deploy check to ensure scale policy values are validated by CI.

anna (ops): I'll add runbook step for cache-warm-up signalling to prevent premature routing to cold pods.

maria (comms): Closing thread and will add public resolved copy to the incident archive. :thumbsup:
